title: Shannon Rogers
text: Shannon Rogers is the co-author of the Beast Academy Practice books. She joined Beast Academy in 2011. While attending UCLA, Shannon spent nearly three years volunteering in classrooms at the UCLA Lab School. She also worked with the Los Angeles Math Circle (LAMC) for two years and was the Lead Instructor for the LAMC Junior Group in 2010. Shannon was also a teaching assistant for Johns Hopkins University's Center for Talented Youth Summer Program in 2010. Currently, in addition to her work with Beast Academy, Shannon is a teacher for the 5th and 6th grade group of the San Diego Math Circle.
